items.title: Carry the blue flame to the lab

title_i18n.en: Carry the blue flame to the lab

description_i18n.en: Use a torch from the village furnace, lighting lanterns along the route; wait for rain to stop.

items.details:
Use a wooden torch rather than a weapon you need for combat. Light it at the ancient furnace in Hateno, then walk toward the lab, lighting the blue-flame lanterns along the road. These become recovery points if the torch goes out.

Avoid sprinting, climbing or putting the torch away while carrying the flame. Rain extinguishes it, so wait for dry weather before restarting from the last lit lantern. At the lab, light the furnace outside, then speak to Purah; merely arriving with a burning torch does not restore the Camera.

details_i18n.en:
Use a wooden torch rather than a weapon you need for combat. Light it at the ancient furnace in Hateno, then walk toward the lab, lighting the blue-flame lanterns along the road. These become recovery points if the torch goes out.

Avoid sprinting, climbing or putting the torch away while carrying the flame. Rain extinguishes it, so wait for dry weather before restarting from the last lit lantern. At the lab, light the furnace outside, then speak to Purah; merely arriving with a burning torch does not restore the Camera.
details_i18n.pt:
Use uma tocha de madeira em vez de uma arma importante para combate. Acenda-a na fornalha antiga de Hateno e caminhe até o laboratório, acendendo as lanternas de chama azul pelo caminho. Elas servem como pontos de recuperação se a tocha apagar.

Evite correr, escalar ou guardar a tocha durante o transporte. A chuva apaga a chama; espere o tempo secar e recomece pela última lanterna acesa. No laboratório, acenda a fornalha externa e fale com Purah; apenas chegar com a tocha acesa não restaura a Câmera.

items.title: Gather at least 20 Shock Arrows
items.description: Collect them around Ploymus Mountain or bring purchased arrows. Sneak past the Lynel; killing it is unnecessary.

description_i18n.en: Collect them around Ploymus Mountain or bring purchased arrows. Sneak past the Lynel; killing it is unnecessary.

items.details:
Check your inventory before climbing Ploymus Mountain: Shock Arrows you already own count toward the requested supply. Near the Lynel, stay out of its sight and collect arrows lodged in trees and the ground. You can also bring purchased arrows.

Defeating the Lynel is optional. If it notices you, retreat rather than spending your weapons on a fight that is unnecessary for boarding Vah Ruta. Return to Sidon once you have at least 20 arrows and the Zora Armor.

details_i18n.en:
Check your inventory before climbing Ploymus Mountain: Shock Arrows you already own count toward the requested supply. Near the Lynel, stay out of its sight and collect arrows lodged in trees and the ground. You can also bring purchased arrows.

Defeating the Lynel is optional. If it notices you, retreat rather than spending your weapons on a fight that is unnecessary for boarding Vah Ruta. Return to Sidon once you have at least 20 arrows and the Zora Armor.
details_i18n.pt:
Confira o inventário antes de subir o Monte Ploymus: as Flechas Elétricas que você já tem contam para o pedido. Perto do Lynel, fique fora de sua visão e recolha flechas presas nas árvores e no chão. Você também pode trazer flechas compradas.

Derrotar o Lynel é opcional. Se ele notar sua presença, recue em vez de gastar armas numa luta desnecessária para entrar em Vah Ruta. Volte a Sidon com pelo menos 20 flechas e a Armadura Zora.

items.title: Solve the waterwheel rooms
items.description: Change the trunk's water flow and use Stasis on mechanisms to reach the wheel terminals.

description_i18n.en: Change the trunk's water flow and use Stasis on mechanisms to reach the wheel terminals.
description_i18n.pt: Mude o fluxo de água da tromba e use Stasis nos mecanismos para alcançar os terminais das rodas.

items.details:
For the smaller wheel, watch the terminal rotate until it is accessible near the bottom. Create a Cryonis pillar at the water outlet to interrupt the stream and stop the wheel in a useful position. Remove the pillar when you need the wheel moving again.

For the larger wheel, adjust Ruta's trunk from the dungeon map so water reaches its mechanism. Use the turning wheel to reach higher platforms instead of trying to climb the smooth structure. Inspect each newly exposed opening before changing the water flow again; reversing an adjustment can move the terminal out of reach.

details_i18n.en:
For the smaller wheel, watch the terminal rotate until it is accessible near the bottom. Create a Cryonis pillar at the water outlet to interrupt the stream and stop the wheel in a useful position. Remove the pillar when you need the wheel moving again.

For the larger wheel, adjust Ruta's trunk from the dungeon map so water reaches its mechanism. Use the turning wheel to reach higher platforms instead of trying to climb the smooth structure. Inspect each newly exposed opening before changing the water flow again; reversing an adjustment can move the terminal out of reach.
details_i18n.pt:
Na roda menor, observe o terminal girar até ficar acessível perto da parte inferior. Crie um pilar de Cryonis na saída de água para interromper o fluxo e parar a roda numa posição útil. Remova o pilar quando precisar que a roda volte a girar.

Na roda maior, ajuste a tromba pelo mapa para a água alcançar o mecanismo. Use a roda em movimento para chegar às plataformas altas em vez de tentar escalar a estrutura lisa. Examine cada abertura exposta antes de mudar o fluxo novamente; desfazer o ajuste pode afastar o terminal.

items.title: Defeat Waterblight Ganon
items.description: Dodge the spear, shoot the eye and attack when it falls. Break the second phase's ice projectiles with Cryonis.

description_i18n.en: Dodge the spear, shoot the eye and attack when it falls. Break the second phase's ice projectiles with Cryonis.
description_i18n.pt: Desvie da lança, acerte o olho e ataque quando ele cair. Quebre os projéteis de gelo da segunda fase com Cryonis.

items.details:
Keep enough distance to read the spear attack, then dodge sideways or use cover rather than trading hits. Aim arrows at the eye and move in for melee attacks when Waterblight falls. Conserve stamina so you can reposition after attacking.

When the arena floods, move between the raised platforms and switch to Cryonis to break incoming ice blocks before they reach you. Return to the bow when the path is clear. If the boss appears on a distant platform, attack from range instead of swimming directly into its next spear strike.

details_i18n.en:
Keep enough distance to read the spear attack, then dodge sideways or use cover rather than trading hits. Aim arrows at the eye and move in for melee attacks when Waterblight falls. Conserve stamina so you can reposition after attacking.

When the arena floods, move between the raised platforms and switch to Cryonis to break incoming ice blocks before they reach you. Return to the bow when the path is clear. If the boss appears on a distant platform, attack from range instead of swimming directly into its next spear strike.
details_i18n.pt:
Mantenha distância suficiente para perceber o ataque da lança e desvie para o lado ou use cobertura, sem trocar golpes. Mire flechas no olho e aproxime-se para atacar quando Waterblight cair. Preserve vigor para mudar de posição depois dos ataques.

Quando a arena alagar, mova-se entre as plataformas elevadas e use Cryonis para quebrar os blocos de gelo antes de atingirem você. Volte ao arco quando houver segurança. Se o chefe aparecer numa plataforma distante, ataque de longe em vez de nadar diretamente até o próximo golpe de lança.

items.title: Defeat Fireblight and free Rudania
items.description: Dodge sword attacks; when it inhales behind its shield, throw in a Remote Bomb and detonate it. Take the heart, activate the main unit and report to Bludo.

description_i18n.en: Dodge sword attacks; when it inhales behind its shield, throw in a Remote Bomb and detonate it. Take the heart, activate the main unit and report to Bludo.
description_i18n.pt: Desvie da espada; quando ele sugar ar protegido pelo escudo, jogue uma Bomba Remota e detone-a. Pegue o coração, ative a unidade central e volte a Bludo.

items.details:
Keep your volcanic protection active throughout the battle and stay clear of the large sword's reach. Move around its swings and attack after the sequence ends. Avoid using Bomb Arrows in this hot environment: they can explode before reaching the target.

During the protected phase, wait until Fireblight begins drawing in air. Throw a Remote Bomb toward the suction, let it be pulled inside and detonate it to break the defense. Run in for a short attack while the boss is down, then prepare to dodge again. Collect the Heart Container before activating the main control unit.

details_i18n.en:
Keep your volcanic protection active throughout the battle and stay clear of the large sword's reach. Move around its swings and attack after the sequence ends. Avoid using Bomb Arrows in this hot environment: they can explode before reaching the target.

During the protected phase, wait until Fireblight begins drawing in air. Throw a Remote Bomb toward the suction, let it be pulled inside and detonate it to break the defense. Run in for a short attack while the boss is down, then prepare to dodge again. Collect the Heart Container before activating the main control unit.
details_i18n.pt:
Mantenha a proteção contra o calor vulcânico durante toda a batalha e fique fora do alcance da espada grande. Contorne os golpes e ataque quando a sequência terminar. Evite Flechas Bomba nesse ambiente quente: elas podem explodir antes de chegar ao alvo.

Na fase protegida, espere Fireblight começar a sugar ar. Jogue uma Bomba Remota na direção da sucção, espere ser puxada e detone para quebrar a defesa. Aproxime-se para atacar brevemente enquanto o chefe estiver caído e prepare outra esquiva. Pegue o Recipiente de Coração antes de ativar a unidade central.

items.title: Defeat Thunderblight and free Naboris
items.description: Block or dodge its dash and counterattack. Lift a metal pillar beside it with Magnesis during the lightning phase; afterward take the heart, activate the main unit and report to Riju.

description_i18n.en: Block or dodge its dash and counterattack. Lift a metal pillar beside it with Magnesis during the lightning phase; afterward take the heart, activate the main unit and report to Riju.
description_i18n.pt: Bloqueie ou desvie da investida e contra-ataque. Erga um pilar ao lado dele com Magnesis na fase dos raios; depois pegue o coração, ative a unidade central e volte a Riju.

items.details:
Keep a shield ready for the rapid approach, then counter after the attack sequence or after breaking its guard. Avoid committing to long weapon combinations that leave you exposed to the next dash. Prepare healing and shock resistance before starting if this timing is difficult.

When metal pillars fall, leave their landing area and equip Magnesis. Grab a pillar and lift it beside Thunderblight, close enough that its lightning hits the pillar and the boss together. You do not need to throw the pillar. After the resulting stun, return to your weapon and resume short, controlled attacks.

details_i18n.en:
Keep a shield ready for the rapid approach, then counter after the attack sequence or after breaking its guard. Avoid committing to long weapon combinations that leave you exposed to the next dash. Prepare healing and shock resistance before starting if this timing is difficult.

When metal pillars fall, leave their landing area and equip Magnesis. Grab a pillar and lift it beside Thunderblight, close enough that its lightning hits the pillar and the boss together. You do not need to throw the pillar. After the resulting stun, return to your weapon and resume short, controlled attacks.
details_i18n.pt:
Mantenha um escudo pronto para a aproximação rápida e contra-ataque após a sequência ou ao quebrar a guarda. Evite combinações longas que deixem você exposto à próxima investida. Prepare cura e resistência elétrica antes da luta se o tempo dos golpes for difícil.

Quando caírem pilares metálicos, saia da área de impacto e equipe Magnesis. Pegue um pilar e erga-o ao lado de Thunderblight, perto o suficiente para o raio atingir o pilar e o chefe juntos. Não é preciso arremessar o pilar. Após o atordoamento, volte à arma e retome ataques curtos e controlados.

items.title: Follow the wind through the fog

title_i18n.en: Follow the wind through the fog

items.description: Follow the lit braziers, then read the wind from a torch's drifting embers; retreat when fog thickens.

description_i18n.en: Follow the lit braziers, then read the wind from a torch's drifting embers; retreat when fog thickens.

items.details:
Follow the lit braziers through the first section and stop at the last clear landmark before wandering farther. Light a torch at the last braziers and observe the direction in which its embers drift. Walk in that direction, pausing periodically to read the wind again rather than following a single bearing across the whole forest.

If the fog thickens around Link, back away immediately toward the last safe ground. Running deeper usually triggers a reset. Once you reach Korok Forest, activate its shrine before exploring or attempting the sword, giving yourself a reliable return point outside the fog maze.

details_i18n.en:
Follow the lit braziers through the first section and stop at the last clear landmark before wandering farther. Light a torch at the last braziers and observe the direction in which its embers drift. Walk in that direction, pausing periodically to read the wind again rather than following a single bearing across the whole forest.

If the fog thickens around Link, back away immediately toward the last safe ground. Running deeper usually triggers a reset. Once you reach Korok Forest, activate its shrine before exploring or attempting the sword, giving yourself a reliable return point outside the fog maze.
details_i18n.pt:
Siga os braseiros acesos na primeira parte e pare no último ponto claro antes de avançar. Acenda uma tocha nos últimos braseiros e observe para onde as brasas se deslocam. Caminhe nessa direção e pare periodicamente para ler o vento novamente, em vez de seguir uma direção fixa por toda a floresta.

Se a neblina engrossar ao redor de Link, recue imediatamente até o último trecho seguro. Correr mais fundo costuma reiniciar o percurso. Ao chegar à Floresta Korok, ative o santuário antes de explorar ou tentar retirar a espada, garantindo um retorno confiável fora do labirinto de neblina.
